```{r local G calculation functions}
calculate_gi_star <- function(data_group, cell_type) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(data_group)
  immune_counts <- data_group[[cell_type]]
  cell_type_name = substr(cell_type, 5, nchar(cell_type))
  region_id <- data_group$Parent

  # Create neighbor matrix
  nb <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = 200)

  # Convert neighbor matrix to spatial weights
  weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
  if(!length(immune_counts) >0 ){
    gi_zval <- 0
    gi_pval <- 1
    gi_padj <- 1
  } else{
    # Calculate Gi* statistics
    gi_zval <- as.numeric(localG(immune_counts, weights, GeoDa = TRUE, zero.policy = T))
  
    # Calculate p-values
    gi_pval <- format.pval(pnorm(2 * (abs(gi_zval)), lower.tail = FALSE), 2)
    # gi_padj <- format.pval(p.adjustSP(pnorm(2 * (abs(gi_zval)), lower.tail = FALSE), nb, "bonferroni"), 2)
    gi_zval <- ifelse(gi_pval <= 0.05, gi_zval, 0)
  }
  # Combine results into a tibble
  tibble(
    wsi = unique(data_group$wsi),
    region_id = region_id,
    # attention_score = data_group$attention_score,
    !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type_name, "_zval") := gi_zval
  )
}

# Main function to process the region level data
process_region_level <- function(region_level, cell_type_list) {
  spatial_data <- st_as_sf(region_level, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 3857)
    wsi_results_list <- map(cell_type_list, ~ calculate_gi_star(spatial_data, .x))
    wsi_results <- Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = c("wsi", "region_id")), wsi_results_list)

  return(wsi_results)
  }


# # Process the region level data for each wsi in parallel
process_single_wsi <- function(wsi, region_level, cell_type_list) {
  wsi_data <- region_level %>% filter(wsi == !!wsi)
  print(paste0("Running ", wsi))
  # output_folder_wsi <- file.path(output_folder, wsi)
  data_with_gi <- process_region_level(wsi_data, cell_type_list)
  return(data_with_gi)
}
```

```{r attn_specific_mean_g}


Local_getisOrd <- readRDS(file.path(temp_folder, "getis_wsi_local_temp.RDS"))
                              
Local_getisOrd <- Local_getisOrd %>%
    mutate(attention_score = as.numeric(as.character(attention_score)))

summary_local_results <- data.frame(wsi = character())
cell_type_list_df <- c("Lymphocyte", "Plasma", "LymphoPlasma", "Immune")

for (attn_group in c(0, 1, 2)) {
  # Filter data based on attention score
  if (attn_group == 0) {
    filtered_data <- Local_getisOrd %>% filter(attention_score < 0.5)
  } else if (attn_group == 1) {
    filtered_data <- Local_getisOrd %>% filter(attention_score >= 0.5)
  } else {
    filtered_data <- Local_getisOrd
  }

  for (cell_type in cell_type_list_df) {
    # Calculate the mean for each cell type and attention group
    attn_cell_mean <- filtered_data %>%
      group_by(wsi) %>%
      summarize(
        !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_hotspot_intensity_attn", attn_group) :=
          mean(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]][.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]] > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_coldspot_intensity_attn", attn_group) :=
          mean(abs(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]][.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]] < 0]), na.rm = TRUE),
        # !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_hotspot_fraction_attn", attn_group) :=
        #   mean(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        # !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_coldspot_fraction_attn", attn_group) :=
        #   mean(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_clustering_strength_attn", attn_group) :=
          mean(abs(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]]), na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_clustering_heterogeneity_attn", attn_group) :=
          sd(.data[[paste0("Gi_star_", cell_type, "_zval")]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    # Join the results
    summary_local_results <- left_join(attn_cell_mean,summary_local_results, by = "wsi")
  }
}
summary_local_results <- summary_local_results%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(starts_with("Gi")), ~  replace_na(., 0)))
  

saveRDS(summary_local_results, file.path(temp_folder, "getis_local_summary_temp.RDS"))
```

```{r Global functions}

calculate_global_Getis <- function(data_group, cell_type,attn_group) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(data_group)
  immune_counts <- data_group[[cell_type]]
  cell_type_name = substr(cell_type, 5, nchar(cell_type))
    # Create neighbor matrix
    nb <- dnearneigh(coords, d1 = 0, d2 = 200)
  if(length(immune_counts) == 0 || length(nb) == 0 || sum(!is.na(immune_counts)) < 3) {
    global_g <- 0
    pval <- 1
  } else {
    # Convert neighbor matrix to spatial weights
    weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate Global G statistics
    global_g_df <- globalG.test(immune_counts, weights, zero.policy = TRUE, na.action = na.omit)
    global_g <- if (global_g_df$p.value <= 0.05) {
      as.numeric(global_g_df$estimate[1])  # Extract numeric value
    } else {
      0
    }

  }
  
  result <- tibble(wsi = unique(data_group$wsi))
  result[[paste0("GlobalG_", cell_type_name, "_attn", attn_group)]] <- global_g
  return(result)
  
}

process_global <- function(region_level, attn_group) {

  spatial_data <- st_as_sf(region_level, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 3857)
  cell_type_list <- c("Num.Lymphocyte", "Num.Plasma", "Num.LymphoPlasma", "Num.Immune")
  wsi_results <- NULL

  for (cell_type in cell_type_list) {
    # Use safely to handle errors in calculate_global_Getis
    safe_calculate_global_Getis <- safely(calculate_global_Getis)

    # Calculate Gi* for the current cell type
    globalg_results <- spatial_data %>%
      group_by(wsi) %>%
      group_split() %>%
      map_df(~ {
        result <- safe_calculate_global_Getis(.x, cell_type, attn_group)
        if (is.null(result$error)) {
          return(result$result)
        } else {
          message("Skipping a group due to error: ", result$error$message)
          return(NULL)
        }
      }) %>%
      bind_rows() %>%
      filter(!is.na(wsi))  # Ensure we only keep valid results

    # Add the Gi* results as new columns to the main data frame
    if (is.null(wsi_results)) {
      wsi_results <- globalg_results
    } else {
      wsi_results <- left_join(wsi_results, globalg_results, by = "wsi")
    }
  }
  return(wsi_results)
}

process_single_wsi_global <- function(wsi, region_level, attn_group) {
  tryCatch({
    wsi_data <- region_level %>% filter(wsi == !!wsi)
    data_with_gi <- process_global(wsi_data,attn_group)
    return(data_with_gi)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error processing wsi ", wsi, ": ", e$message)
    # Return a tibble with the expected structure but with NA values
    return(tibble(wsi = as.character(wsi)))
  })
}

```


```{r run global}

region_level<- region_level%>%
    mutate(attention_score = as.numeric(as.character(attention_score)))

global_getis <- NULL
for (attn_group in c(0,1, 2)) {
  # Filter data based on attention score
  if (attn_group == 0) {
    filtered_data <- region_level %>% filter(attention_score < 0.5)
  } else if (attn_group == 1) {
    filtered_data <- region_level %>% filter(attention_score >= 0.5)
  } else {
    filtered_data <- region_level
  }

  # Process each wsi and collect results
  global_getis_attn <- future_map(
    unique_wsis,
    ~ process_single_wsi_global(.x, filtered_data,attn_group),
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
    .progress = TRUE
  ) %>%
    bind_rows() 

  # Combine results
  if (is.null(global_getis)) {
    global_getis <- global_getis_attn
  } else {
    global_getis <- full_join(global_getis, global_getis_attn, by = "wsi")
  }
}

global_getis_df <- global_getis%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(starts_with("GlobalG_")), ~  replace_na(., 0)))

```
